sheet.title: Print badges
sheet.description: An A4 sheet of 10 card-size badges, with crop marks.
sheet.languageHint: Names and the comparsa are not translated.
sheet.noPhoto_one: {{count}} without an ID photo: an empty frame to paste one in.
sheet.noPhoto_other: {{count}} without an ID photo: an empty frame to paste one in.
sheet.noLicense_one: {{count}} without an issued license: the expiry date is left blank.
sheet.noLicense_other: {{count}} without an issued license: the expiry date is left blank.
sheet.noLogo: No Federation logo uploaded: the badges print without it.
sheet.printNote: Print at 100 % scale (actual size, not “fit to page”) on cardstock and cut along the marks.
sheet.failedTitle: The badges could not be generated

selection.label: Selection
selection.limit: A PDF holds at most {{max}} badges: remove some from the selection.
selection.removed_one: {{count}} arquebusier is no longer in the registry: they leave the selection when you close.
selection.removed_other: {{count}} arquebusiers are no longer in the registry: they leave the selection when you close.

errors.tooMany: A PDF holds at most 200 badges. Print a selection instead.
errors.photoUnreadable: The ID photo of {{names}} cannot be read. Upload it again or leave them out of the selection.
errors.photoUnreadableCount_one: The ID photo of {{count}} arquebusier cannot be read. Upload it again or leave them out.
errors.photoUnreadableCount_other: The ID photos of {{count}} arquebusiers cannot be read. Upload them again or leave them out.
errors.busy: Other badges are being generated. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.auditUnavailable: The download could not be recorded. Try again.
errors.storageUnavailable: The photos and the logo cannot be read right now. Try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: You downloaded many documents in a row. Wait a minute.
